deacon-vane.name: Deacon Vane
deacon-vane.note: Tent-revival preacher: deep, rolling, unhurried; every taunt is a sermon.

reference.text: Brothers and sisters, gather close. The road is long and the shoulder is narrow, and every one of us will answer for the miles we ride. I have seen the light, and it was a headlight.

dial-up.name: Dial-Up
dial-up.note: Screeching speed freak: high, fast, wired, words tumbling over each other.

reference.text: Okay okay okay, hold on, I'm connecting. Hear that screech? That's me. Fastest thing on the road since nineteen ninety-six, and I never, ever log off. Never.

chad-speedwell.name: Chad Speedwell
chad-speedwell.note: Livestreaming influencer: bright, upbeat, always performing for the chat.

reference.text: What is up, everybody, welcome back to the channel! Today we are racing, we are crashing, and we are absolutely not reading the comments. Let's get into it.

kevin-from-accounting.name: Kevin from Accounting
kevin-from-accounting.note: Deadpan office menace: flat, precise, quietly vicious.

reference.text: Hi. Just following up on the previous thread. I have reviewed the numbers, and the numbers are not good. I will be blocking out time to address this. With you. Personally.

tammy-two-stroke.name: Tammy Two-Stroke
tammy-two-stroke.note: Chain-smoking auntie: warm, low, sugar-sweet with a scrap underneath.

reference.text: Well, sit down, honey, you look tired. I've been riding this road since before they paved it, and I'll be riding it after they quit. Now, who wants iced tea?

the-mayor.name: The Mayor
the-mayor.note: Small-town politician: booming podium voice, all spin.

reference.text: My fellow citizens, it is a great honor to stand before you today. This town has given me everything, and I intend to give it right back, with interest, after the election.

mother-rust.name: Mother Rust
mother-rust.note: Swamp-town matriarch: low, slow, eerily calm.

reference.text: Come on in out of the heat, child. The water's warm and the gators are fed. Family looks after family down here. Everybody else, well. Everybody else finds out.

sgt-pruitt.name: Sgt. Pruitt
sgt-pruitt.note: Tired county deputy: slow, weary, twenty-two years of this.

reference.text: Alright. Alright. Let me just get my notepad. Long day, long road, and somehow it's always the same people. I'm not mad. I'm just tired. Real tired.

juniper-moss.name: Juniper Moss
juniper-moss.note: Espresso-stand barista: bright customer-service voice, passive-aggressive.

reference.text: Hi there, welcome in! What can I get started for you today? Oat milk is extra, the line is long, and yes, I saw you cut it. It's fine. Totally fine.

old-growth.name: Old Growth
old-growth.note: Logger the size of a stump: very deep, very slow, one sentence a mile.

reference.text: Morning. Rain's coming. Trees don't mind it, and neither do I. Been working these hills a long time. Don't talk much. Don't need to. Never have.

deputy-lindqvist.name: Deputy Lindqvist
deputy-lindqvist.note: Soft-spoken deputy: gentle, polite, never raises his voice.

reference.text: Good morning. No, no, you're not in trouble. Not yet. I'm just going to write a few things down here, if that's alright with you. Take your time.

gripman-gus.name: Gripman Gus
gripman-gus.note: Retired cable-car gripman: gravelly old-timer, a showman.

reference.text: Ding ding, folks, hold on tight. Forty years I worked these hills, rain or fog, and I never once lost a car. Lost a few passengers. Never a car.

pivot.name: Pivot
pivot.note: Pre-revenue founder: quick, upbeat pitch voice, never stops selling.

reference.text: So, quick context. We're building the future of getting places. Think rides, but leaner. We're pre-launch, pre-revenue, and frankly, pre-everything. Let me show you the deck.

officer-meter.name: Officer Meter
officer-meter.note: Parking officer: nasal, procedural, has never let anything go.

reference.text: Excuse me. This vehicle is parked eleven inches from the curb. The limit is ten. I'm writing it up. You can contest it by mail. Nobody ever wins.

base:dial-up-core#dial-up-lead-56k.spoken: Fifty-six K and still in first. Do the math.

base:dial-up-core#dial-up-crash-dignity.spoken: Error four oh four. Dignity not found.

base:kevin-core#kevin-lead-forecast.spoken: Leading. As forecast in Q three.

base:kevin-core#kevin-hit-mayor.spoken: Invoice zero zero four two. Paid in full, Mayor.

base:kevin-core#kevin-near-hr.spoken: Flagging that near miss for H.R.
